summary.text: Eddie Andrews is a Republican state representative for Iowa House District 43 and has served in the Iowa House since 2021.

paragraphs.text: The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Andrews as a tech entrepreneur, app developer and bilingual minister, with a B.S. in electrical and computer engineering from the University of Iowa, raised in Des Moines and living in Johnston.
It lists Andrews as the founder of #mentoromics, which provides free coding and entrepreneurial skills to youth.
